artists.biography:
Johnny Marr (born 31 October 1963) is an English musician and songwriter. Marr was co-songwriter – with Morrissey – and guitarist of The Smiths between 1982–87. He also was a member of Electronic, The The and Modest Mouse. In 2008, he joined The Cribs after touring with them on 2008's NME Awards Tour, a group in which he would remain until 2011. In 2012 Marr announced he would be releasing a solo album titled The Messenger.
In 2013, the NME awarded Marr its Godlike Genius award, hailing Marr as "not content with rewriting the history of music with one of the world's greatest ever bands, The Smiths, he's continued to push boundaries and evolve throughout his career, working with some of the best and most exciting artists on the planet." He was voted the fourth best guitarist of the last 30 years in a poll conducted by the BBC in 2010. Phil Alexander, Editor-in-Chief of Mojo, has described Marr as "arguably Britain's last great guitar stylist".

perplexity.description:
Fever Dreams Pts 1-4 is Johnny Marr's fourth solo studio album, released in February 2022 via BMG. The double album represents his most expansive work to date, showcasing the guitarist and songwriter's continued evolution as a solo artist following his departure from The Smiths and subsequent work with bands like Electronic and Modest Mouse. The album's ambitious scope and scale mark a significant statement in Marr's post-Smiths career, demonstrating his willingness to explore broader sonic territories beyond the guitar-driven alternative rock that defined his earlier work.

The album received positive critical reception upon its release, with reviewers noting that Marr had reached new creative heights with the project. The double album format allowed Marr to explore diverse musical textures and arrangements across its extended runtime, blending rock and pop sensibilities while maintaining the melodic sophistication and instrumental craftsmanship that have characterized his work throughout his career. The release reinforced Marr's status as a significant figure in contemporary rock music, capable of sustaining artistic relevance and innovation decades into his professional life.
